description: A web‑based habit tracker that lets users define daily habits, mark completions, view streaks, and explore their habit history.
target_users: Individuals looking to build or maintain personal routines
Students who want to track study and wellness habits
Professionals aiming to improve productivity through habit metrics
core_features: Create, edit, and delete daily habits
Mark habit completion for the current day
future_features: Social sharing of streaks and leaderboards
Export of habit data and analytics dashboards

milestones: Create habit CRUD endpoints and UI
Add daily completion logging and streak calculation
Deploy basic dashboard with habit list and history view
Introduce habit reminders via email/push notifications
Build habit analytics page with charts
Add user profile settings and habit toggling UI improvements
Implement social sharing and leaderboard functionality
Provide data export (CSV) and advanced reporting
Optimize performance and prepare for mobile‑responsive design
